hero.title: Procurement se Profit
hero.description: WorkWise turns procurement into a profit centre for hospitality. Run RFQs, tenders and negotiations across every hotel on one platform and know you paid the right price, every single time.

usp.heading: AI Powered Procurement Platform
usp.description: From RFQ to PO in one place. AI shortlists the right vendors, compares every quote line by line, and holds one negotiated rate across all your hotels.

problem.heading: Hospitality teams are stuck doing things the hard way
problem.subheading: Manual comparisons, disconnected business units, and vendor bias are quietly costing you money on every order.

points.title: Comparing quotes takes days
points.description: Copy-pasting numbers from PDFs and emails into spreadsheets is slow, manual, and it's easy to miss the best rate buried in the details.

points.title: The same material, different rates
points.description: Different business units unknowingly pay different prices for the exact same material, because no one has visibility across plants.

points.title: Vendor relationships bias evaluation
points.description: Long-standing relationships can quietly influence who wins, so the best price doesn't always win the order.

solution.heading: One platform, from BOQ to final payment
solution.subheading: Purpose-built tools that make sure you always know the right price, everywhere, from everyone.

points.title: AI-Generated Price Comparison Chart
points.description: Every quote is instantly normalized and plotted side-by-side, so the best rate across vendors is obvious in seconds, not spreadsheets.

points.title: One Material, One Rate — Across Business Units
points.description: The same material always shows the same negotiated rate everywhere in your organization, so no plant or team overpays for something another unit already sourced cheaper.

points.title: Vendor Masking
points.description: Vendor identities stay hidden during evaluation, so quotes are compared purely on price and specification, not relationships.

journey.heading: How our platform works, end to end
journey.subheading: Three steps from raising a requirement to paying the vendor with every quote, round and approval tracked along the way.

steps.title: Create an RFQ/Tender
steps.description: Related vendors are auto-selected now you can publish for quotations or schedule for later.

steps.title: Compare & negotiate
steps.description: Negotiate freely with your selected vendor on any field unit price, packaging, documents, taxes and more across as many rounds as you need.

steps.title: Issue PO & track payments
steps.description: Convert the winning quote into a purchase order, route it through your hotel's approval chain, and track it right up to GRN and payment.

whatYouGet.heading: What will you get as a buyer
whatYouGet.subheading: Everything your procurement team needs to buy better across every property, without adding headcount.

benefits.title: Lower procurement cost
benefits.description: Competitive quotes and structured negotiation rounds consistently take 6-9% off what you were paying before.

benefits.title: Faster turnaround
benefits.description: Quote collection and comparison that used to take days now happens in hours, so projects stop waiting on procurement.

benefits.title: Access to verified vendors
benefits.description: Tap a network of 12,500+ verified suppliers, or bring your own — both work the same way on the platform.

benefits.title: Full visibility & control
benefits.description: See live status of every RFQ, tender, negotiation and PO across all your hotels from a single dashboard.

benefits.title: Clean audit trail
benefits.description: Every quote, revision, approval and comment is timestamped and stored, so audits stop being a scramble.

benefits.title: Dedicated support
benefits.description: Onboarding, vendor discovery and day-to-day help from a team that knows hospitality procurement.

items.quote: WorkWise gave us one rate across every property and complete transparency in vendor evaluation. Our procurement is now faster, cleaner and far easier to control.
items.author: Nitin Rajenimbalkar
items.position: DGM - Procurement, The Orchid Hotels, Kamat Group
